description: Get the current Bitcoin price in USD and other major currencies. Source: mempool.space. Real-time. Each reading carries source (the URL read), fetched_at (UTC, RFC 3339) and source_sha256 (SHA-256 of the upstream body as served).

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 0 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

name: btc_price
